pilot.limits: Single Claude scenario, warm/cache-exposed infrastructure; source patches and worker exposure differ between runs. No matched current-suite or whole-gate control. Outage occurs after a completed turn and uses graceful Runtime stop; active-work crash recovery is untested. Dispatcher receipt replay does not isolate Runtime deduplication. Lost-journal control fails before receipt assertions. Real controllers, kubelet, packaging, VM/Firecracker, app and browser are absent. retained_baseline.limits: Retained latest-head cohort, not recollected. Successful percentiles exclude failed/cancelled heads. Workflow creation proxies unavailable push timestamps; superseded heads excluded. Not an all-push flake rate.

retained_pod_action.limits: One earlier physical action/load; cases overlap. The native pilot covers fewer guarantees and is not a matched control. No subtraction yields CI savings.

adoption_protocol.clock: Exact-head workflow creation until all three required checks complete successfully, push timestamps when available; record first-pass and rerun-inclusive outcomes separately. Failed/cancelled/missing outcomes retained.
adoption_protocol.coverage_stop: Any unique assertion without a retained owner, reviewed fault escape, vacuous negative, unexplained new failure/cleanup signature or state leak retains current gate.
adoption_protocol.frequency_tradeoff: No gate/frequency change in pilot. Any later removal of duplicate full-stack coverage requires its own explicit reviewed coverage decision and acceptance evidence.
adoption_protocol.limits: Screening thresholds are proposed. Sparse strata and uncertainty must be published. Zero failures in 100 independent executions still permits about a 3 percent one-sided 95 percent upper failure bound.
